sources.facts: Vatican identifies Maderno’s travertine facade, Corinthian columns and pilasters, and 13 statues above the attic. Christ is 6 m tall and the Apostles and John the Baptist 5.65 m. Two clocks flank the attic and Loggia of Benedictions is in the middle.
Vatican distinguishes drum, double dome shell and lantern. Interior height to the lantern vault is 117.57 m. The published height to the summit of the cross of 133.30 m uses an internal datum.
The Fabbrica gives about 187 m of internal length and 136 m to the top of the dome. The model follows the exterior mapped extent and overall exterior height.
The external facade measures approximately 115 m across. An exterior staircase in three runs connects the basilica to the foot of the facade.
